chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"Indeed, between this world and the Hereafter there are a thousand obstacles, the easiest and least difficult of them is death."

key_terms.الْآخِرَةِ: the Hereafter, the final abode after worldly life
key_terms.الْمَوْتُ: death, the transition from worldly life

ai.seo_question: What does the Imam عليه السلام say about the hardships between the world and the Hereafter?
ai.summary: The Imam عليه السلام teaches that the passage from this world to the Hereafter involves many grave stages and hardships. Death, though feared by people, is presented as the lightest of these stages, directing the believer toward reflection on what comes after it.
